title: Vemar Sharki

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Shark Vemar Sharki is designed for versatile commuters and touring riders requiring multi-mode adaptability, delivering flip-up versatility for city stops and sealed protection at speed. Built around a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell weighing a solid 1676g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~88 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Feature-packed modular with double sun visor and intercom cavity.

variants.title: Vemar Sharki Gloss Black
variants.description: The Shark Vemar Sharki is a benchmark Modular helmet crafted in France 🇫🇷. Built around Carbon-On-Skin composite structure with CFD aerodynamic wind-tunnel tuned rear spoiler profile, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Engineered for highway touring flexibility, featuring a dual P/J homologated flip-up chinbar, one-handed latch mechanism, and integrated sun visor. French design innovation fusing sharp aesthetic styling with safety.

product_details.description: Feature-packed modular with double sun visor and intercom cavity.

variants.introduction: Positioned in Shark's Modular lineup, the Vemar Sharki brings French engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
variants.story:
The Shark Vemar Sharki represents Shark's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Shark Vemar Sharki delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: Vemar Sharki Gloss Black (gloss finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: Shark Vemar Sharki in Vemar Sharki Gloss Black. The sweet spot for versatile riders wanting flip-up ease for urban errands alongside dependable full-face highway protection.
variants.fitment_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with temple pressure-relief grooves for eyewear. 3D contoured cheek pads experience a 12-15 riding hour break-in period, relaxing by ~15% for facial fitment.

technical_analysis: Features Carbon-On-Skin composite structure with CFD aerodynamic wind-tunnel tuned rear spoiler profile paired with Autoseal visor mechanism pressing the shield onto the helmet gasket for rain and sound insulation. The interior utilizes Bamboo fiber eco-friendly lining with EasyFit glasses grooves for riders wearing spectacles with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Shark Vemar Sharki: combining France 🇫🇷 craftsmanship with Autoseal visor mechanism pressing the shield onto the helmet gasket for rain and sound insulation and Bamboo fiber eco-friendly lining with EasyFit glasses grooves for riders wearing spectacles. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Shark Vemar Sharki: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Shark Vemar Sharki. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Shark Vemar Sharki is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.
